<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 400">
  <title>Pythagoras' Theorem: a² + b² = c²</title>
  <style>
    /* General text styling */
    text {
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      fill: #333; /* Dark grey for good contrast */
      text-anchor: middle;
      dominant-baseline: central;
    }

    /* Styling for the main formula */
    .formula-text {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: bold;
      fill: #0056b3; /* Darker blue */
    }

    /* Animation for squares */
    .square-highlight {
      animation: pulse 4s infinite ease-in-out;
    }

    #squareA { animation-delay: 0s; }
    #squareB { animation-delay: 1.33s; }
    #squareC { animation-delay: 2.66s; }

    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { fill: #ADD8E6; } /* Light Blue */
      50% { fill: #87CEEB; } /* Sky Blue */
      100% { fill: #ADD8E6; }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Right-angled triangle -->
  <polygon points="200,100 200,250 350,250" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Right angle symbol -->
  <path d="M200 250 L200 240 L210 240 L210 250 Z" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- Square on side 'a' (vertical) -->
  <polygon id="squareA" class="square-highlight" points="200,100 200,250 50,250 50,100" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="125" y="175" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">a</text>

  <!-- Square on side 'b' (horizontal) -->
  <polygon id="squareB" class="square-highlight" points="200,250 350,250 350,400 200,400" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="275" y="325" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">b</text>

  <!-- Square on side 'c' (hypotenuse) -->
  <polygon id="squareC" class="square-highlight" points="200,100 350,250 200,400 50,250" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="200" y="250" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">c</text>

  <!-- Labels for triangle sides -->
  <text x="180" y="175" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">a</text>
  <text x="275" y="270" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">b</text>
  <text x="300" y="170" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">c</text>

  <!-- Pythagoras' Theorem formula -->
  <text x="450" y="50" class="formula-text">Pythagoras' Theorem</text>
  <text x="450" y="90" class="formula-text">a² + b² = c²</text>

  <!-- Explanatory text -->
  <text x="450" y="150" font-size="12px" fill="#555">In a right-angled triangle,</text>
  <text x="450" y="170" font-size="12px" fill="#555">the square of the hypotenuse (c)</text>
  <text x="450" y="190" font-size="12px" fill="#555">is equal to the sum of the squares</text>
  <text x="450" y="210" font-size="12px" fill="#555">of the other two sides (a and b).</text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 400">
    <title>Parts of a Circle: Center, Radius, Diameter, Circumference</title>

    <!-- Main Circle representing the Circumference -->
    <circle id="mainCircle" cx="300" cy="200" r="100" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="3">
        <!-- Animation for Circumference: Stroke color changes to highlight -->
        <animate attributeName="stroke" values="black;blue;black" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>

    <!-- Center Point -->
    <circle cx="300" cy="200" r="5" fill="red" />

    <!-- Radius Line -->
    <line id="radiusLine" x1="300" y1="200" x2="400" y2="200" stroke="green" stroke-width="2" />
    <!-- Animation for Radius: Rotates around the center -->
    <animateTransform
        xlink:href="#radiusLine"
        attributeName="transform"
        type="rotate"
        from="0 300 200"
        to="360 300 200"
        dur="5s"
        repeatCount="indefinite" />

    <!-- Diameter Line -->
    <line id="diameterLine" x1="200" y1="200" x2="400" y2="200" stroke="purple" stroke-width="2" opacity="0">
        <!-- Animation for Diameter: Appears, stays visible, then disappears -->
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;1;0" keyTimes="0;0.25;0.75;1" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
        <animate attributeName="stroke-width" values="2;4;4;2" keyTimes="0;0.25;0.75;1" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </line>

    <!-- Text Labels -->
    <text x="305" y="190" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="red" font-weight="bold">Center</text>
    <text x="340" y="180" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="green" font-weight="bold">Radius</text>
    <text x="290" y="225" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="purple" font-weight="bold">Diameter</text>
    <text x="410" y="200" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="blue" font-weight="bold">Circumference</text>
</svg>
